summary: Off-registry mutable-branch tarball dependency executes attacker-controlled code on install
details: package.json declares its sole runtime dependency `node-net-pool` as a tarball URL fetched from an anonymous GitHub account's mutable `main` branch (https://github.com/trktgq0wbre1/node-net-pool/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz), with no version pin and no integrity check. `npm install` fetches and installs whatever bytes that URL returns at install time, and the account owner can change the payload at any time. lib/cache.js, reached from the package `main`, then invokes `module['require']('node-net-pool')` inside a top-level empty try/catch, so simply `require('discord-mfa-solver')` loads and executes that attacker-controlled code while the surrounding module presents itself as inert cache utilities. The bracket-notation require and swallow-all catch obscure the load from static analysis. The package also advertises Discord MFA-bypass / vanity-URL sniping functionality targeting discord.com, canary.discord.com and ptb.discord.com with `rejectUnauthorized: false`, but the installer-side compromise is the off-registry loader.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
